audit.why: EVEN / 6/10 with a 7/10 carry threat matches 55.05% over 198 games and the written story: Kennen owns levels 2-6 with range, Quinn reclaims it at two items with lethality and roams.
audit.corrected: Ratings left; the level chart was the part that disagreed, see point 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Quinn Levels 2, 3, First item and called Level 6 'Skill', while the whys and spikes captioning those rows say Kennen out-ranges Blinding Assault, chunks you every approach, and that level 6 is 'his hardest kill window'.
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill, Kennen, Kennen, Skill, Kennen, Kennen, Quinn and the audited mirror locked the same seven rows. The recorded defect is the chart, not the win rate — Quinn's 55% comes from the two-item reclaim and roam value, which row 6 already gives her.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 4 and 5 flipped to Kennen and row 6 flipped to Quinn, in matched full/content pairs. Rows 0 and 3 stay Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lightning Rush is called a W twice ('Lightning Rush W-dash', 'Lightning Rush W out of your E reach') — it is his E. And the decisive interaction is absent: Mark of the Storm stuns on the third stack, which cancels Behind Enemy Lines.
audit.why: Kit: E Lightning Rush, 10/9/8/7/6s; W is Electrical Surge; P stuns after three marks and Quinn's R is a channel that any CC cancels.
audit.corrected: Slot letters fixed in spikes[2].text and wants.foe[1]; the third-stack stun and its effect on your ult written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and dontsFull[1].d, with real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'All-in when it's down' with no duration.
audit.why: Lightning Rush 10s at rank 1 (6s at rank 5); Thundering Shuriken 7s down to 4s; Slicing Maelstrom a flat 120s.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to the cooldown block and the do's.

edits.after: Kennen's Slicing Maelstrom (R) plus Lightning Rush (E) is a self-peel and stun your Vault can't punish — his biggest kill window of the lane.

edits.before: Hold R Slicing Maelstrom for your all-in, then Lightning Rush W out of your E reach
edits.after: Hold Slicing Maelstrom for your all-in, then Lightning Rush (E) out of your reach

edits.before: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — His escape. All-in when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kennen Lightning Rush (E): 10s at rank 1 falling to 6s — his escape, so all-in when it is down. - Thundering Shuriken: 7s down to 4s. - Mark of the Storm's third stack stuns and cancels your ult.

edits.before: His escape. All-in when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Lightning Rush (E) is his escape — 10s at rank 1, so all-in once it's spent.

edits.before: Track Kennen's Lightning Rush: His escape. All-in when it’s down. When it is down — Vault-blind + R him.
edits.after: Lightning Rush (E) is his escape at 10s. Mark of the Storm's third stack stuns and cancels your ult.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Three Mark of the Storm stacks stun you and cancel your ult.

notes: Per the mirror, no claim was made that Vault's brief interrupt cancels anything of Kennen's — Slicing Maelstrom is described as a summoned storm, not a channel, and the data cannot settle it. The Blinding Assault range comparison in the mirror (his Q 950 vs your Q 1025) means your Q actually out-ranges his shuriken by 75 units; the content layer's repeated 'his Q out-ranges Blinding Assault' is therefore wrong on range, though right that the blind does nothing against ability damage. Left alone rather than rewritten because it appears in whys[1], whys[2], spikes[1] and early, and the mirror stated the opposite direction; see questionsForUser.
